to March</p> <h1>Kitesurfing and Wing in Mozambique</h1> <video src="/images/miniHD-web.mp4" autoplay loop muted playsinline poster="/images/1-spot/9.webp">
Browser incompatible
</video> <p id="intro">Your <em>Kitesurfing and Wingfoil spot in Mozambique</em>, <em>directly on the beach</em> of a magnificent lagoon with clear and shallow waters.</p> <div class="flexi"> <a href="/en/the-kitesurf-spot-in-bilene-mozambique/"> <figure> <img src="/images/accueil/1.webp" alt="kitesurfer in a beautiful landscape" loading="lazy"> <figcaption> <h2>The unique, pristine spot</h2> <p>Discover the Bilene spot, its unique, paradisiacal lagoon. Mozambique, a country <em>untouched by mass tourism</em>, its warm welcome.</p> </figcaption> </figure> </a> <a href="/en/the-kite-center-in-bilene-mozambique/"> <figure> <img src="/images/accueil/2.webp" alt="Kite center on the beach" loading="lazy"> <figcaption> <h2>The Kite Center</h2> <p>A center dedicated to kiting, equipped with showers, storage, chilling area, a secure spot, lessons, rental of this year's Eleveight equipment, guiding in the lagoon, its speed spots, its downwinds, its wave spot.</p> </figcaption> </figure> </a> <a href="/en/kiteschool-in-bilene-mozambique/"> <figure> <img src="/images/accueil/3.webp" alt="kitesurfing lesson" loading="lazy"> <figcaption> <h2>The Kite School</h2> <p>An IKO certified instructor to introduce you to the sport in ideal conditions. Complete equipment of the year. An OLK instructor for freestyle coaching, big air, strapless, waves.</p> </figcaption> </figure> </a> <a href="/en/kite-trips-in-mozambique/"> <figure> <img src="/images/accueil/6.webp" alt="group of people in front of a pristine spot" loading="lazy"> <figcaption> <h2>Trips / Kitesafari / KiteTrip</h2> <p>Mozambique is full of magical spots, for all tastes, we take you to discover them.</p> </figcaption> </figure> </a> <a href="/en/video-professional-mozambique/"> <figure> <img src="/images/accueil/4.webp" alt="kitesurfer during a jump" loading="lazy"> <figcaption> <h2>Pro Videos</h2> <p>From complete rider editing, with slow motions and drone shots to photos or videos of your sessions, your progression during your stay. BKC is a partner of Air Tricks Prod, specialist in kite videos.</p> </figcaption> </figure> </a> <a href="/en/information-mozambique/"> <figure> <img src="/images/accueil/5.webp" alt="team of riders looking at a beautiful landscape" loading="lazy"> <figcaption> <h2>Additional info, accommodation, flights</h2> <p>How to join us, Visas, flights, airport transfers, accommodation, we take care of everything from when you leave the airport.</p> </figcaption> </figure> </a> </div> <section id="avis"> <h2>What the people who came say</h2> <p class="avis-big">126 reviews across three platforms</p> <p class="avis-sub">5.0 average on Google and on Tripadvisor, 100% recommendations on Facebook.
